title: SpectraFit-Core-Reproducibility: every published result of spectrafit-core 0.1.2, regenerated from the release
description: A pinned, thin consumer of the spectrafit-core release that regenerates the NIST StRD agreement tables, the figures and the timing comparison reported in the SoftwareX article on spectrafit-core, on a recorded host (terra, Linux x86-64), and checks every number stated in the text against the regenerated data. The compiled library is the published PyPI wheel; the harness and the figure scripts come from the release tag; the archived timing measurement is verified by SHA-256, not re-measured.
